newsitem.title: USA: Foster Wheeler BOC extend alliance.
newsitem.headline: Foster Wheeler BOC extend alliance.

text.p: BOC Gases and Foster Wheeler Power Systems Inc said Tuesday they established a global agreement to develop, own and operate hydrogen production facilities which will supply large-scale industrial users in the refining, chemical, petrochemical and steel industries.
They said the agreement is a global extension of an alliance formed in mid-1995 by the two companies to work together in the Americas.
Both BOC Group Plc and Foster Wheeler Corp subsidaries will maintain ownership interests throughout the life of a project.
The companies said this combination dedicated to providing reliable, long-term hydrogen supply to their customers is unique in the industry.
As part of the earlier agreement, the two companies are constructing a 50-million-cubic-foot-per-day hydrogen plant in Amuay, Venezuela, which will be completed this summer.

They said the $50 million plant will supply the Lagoven refining complex with hydrogen that will help the refinery produce higher-quality products to meet increasingly stringent environmental demands.
The global alliance establishes both Foster Wheeler, the technology provider, and BOC, the industrial gas company, as partners for the life of the contract, they explained.
Both companies will supply new technologies and long-term customer solutions that will provide the customer with the lowest cost of hydrogen during the lifetime of the plant.

The agreement also calls for the two companies to collaborate on marketing opportunities for syngas and carbon monoxide produced by the hydrogen plants and by-products such as electricity, steam, treated water and other gases.
